'''{{PAGENAME}}''' {{Lang|zh=椋羽}} is an [[NPC]] Server of [[Yuan's Flavors]] of the Xuanfang Hold branch, who manages the Restaurant when [[Fillet Fairmaiden]] is busy.

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Idle==
:'''Lili:''' Yuan's Flavors, your flavors!

==Dialogue==
;(When working)
:{{Icon/Quest|Dialogue Shop|20}} I want to buy some food
:;(Open Shop)
::'''Lili:''' Welcome to Yuan's Flavors, Xuanfang Hold branch!
:;(Purchase)
::'''Lili:''' Eat it while it's hot! Try it once, and you'll be coming back for more!
::(Not enough Shell Credits)
::'''Rover:''' (I'm running low on Shell Credits. Maybe I'll come back another time.)
:[[File:Restaurant Map Marker.png|20px]] Prepare the cooking ingredients
:{{DIcon}} About Fillet Fairmaiden
::'''Lili:''' The Fillet Fairmaiden? Oh, she learned from the head chef himself from when she was a little girl! She's the best fish-slicing chef in Yuan's Flavors, and she's mastered every culinary art there is!
::'''Lili:''' Everyone knew she'd be the next head chef, it was obvious...
::'''Lili:''' But then one day, out of nowhere, she packed up a set of cookware and said she was heading to Xuanfang. To see where Yuan's Flavors first began.
::'''Lili:''' Last I heard, the head chef's still waiting for her to go back to Mengzhou...
::'''Lili:''' Ahem. That's all inside info, by the way. Keep it under your hat, kay?
:{{DIcon|Exit}} 
{{Dialogue End}}
